chain_words.nuance: a negative effect that may be small or temporary
to weaken the normal function or quality of something
to cause physical or lasting harm to something
to reduce the quality of a natural system over time
to destroy something so completely that it cannot recover

explanation: These words all describe harm to something, from a slight negative effect to complete destruction that prevents recovery.

usage_notes.difference: 'Degrade' describes a gradual decline in the quality of an environment; 'devastate' describes sudden and complete destruction.
